name: Churrito Loco
facts: Churrito Loco is at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.
The app has a free 90-second game called Loco Match.
Weekly board: 1st place gets 50% off your next order, 2nd gets 20% off.
Score 4,150+ in one run for 15% off your next order.
The weekly board resets every Monday.
A free Daily Spin is available once per member per day (Los Angeles time).
Reward ladder: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1,100 pts Churros for the table.
Referral gift: a free churro.
Joining offer: a free churro with your next order.
Members need a name, phone number and email. One account per person and per phone.
You must be 13+ to play. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian's OK.
Spin food prizes and discounts last 3 days at the South Gate location.
One reward per visit. Rewards can't be combined.
No purchase is needed to play or win.
Loco Match scoring: 10 pts per snack matched, 4 in a row +40, 5 in a row +100, Churrito Man +150, Serrano -25.
A golden Antidote tile appears once per run. Match next to it for +300.
Menu prices come from the restaurant's public Yelp menu (Sep 2026) and may change, so confirm in store.
Menu has churros, street corn and fries, dogs and drinks.
Prizes shown in the app are samples, so confirm with staff.
Follow @churritoloco on Instagram.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.
No phone number is shown in the app yet.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're open Mon–Thu 12:00p–10:00p, Fri–Sat 12:00p–11:00p, and Sunday 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 12:00p (noon) every day of the week.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Mon–Thu and Sunday we close at 10:00p. Friday and Saturday we close at 11:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes! Saturday is 12:00p–11:00p and Sunday is 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on Fridays and Saturdays late?
qa.a: Yes, Friday and Saturday we stay open until 11:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on holidays?
qa.a: I don't have holiday hours. Please ask staff before you come.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app. It opens us in Google Maps.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show yet. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call to order?
qa.a: The app has a Call to order button, but our number isn't hooked up yet. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff when you visit.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have anything about reservations. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have an Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, we're @churritoloco. Our latest posts and reels show up inside the app too.

qa.q: What is on the menu?
qa.a: We have churros, street corn and fries, dogs, and drinks. Scroll the menu in the app to see everything.

qa.q: What churros do you have?
qa.a: Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49, and the Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry, or chocolate. You pick.

qa.q: What are the plain churros like?
qa.a: The Plain Signature Churros come as 4 pieces rolled in cinnamon sugar for $7.99.

qa.q: What are Churro Bites?
qa.a: Churro Bites Filled are 10 mini filled churros with your choice of fillings, $9.49.

qa.q: What is the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: It's a cone made out of churro, with ice cream, drizzle and topping. It's $9.49.

qa.q: What street corn do you have?
qa.a: Original Corn is a whole corn with mayo, cheese, butter and chili powder ($7.49). Hot Cheetos Corn has mayo, butter and hot Cheeto crumbs ($7.49).

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Original Elote Fries are fries topped with corn, mayo, cheese and butter ($11.49). XL Chili Cheese Fries have chili, cheese and grilled onions ($16.49).

qa.q: What dogs do you have?
qa.a: The Flamin Dog is an all-beef dog with bacon, nacho cheese and hot Cheeto crumbs ($9.49). The Churro Dog is an all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese ($9.49).

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee ($6.49), Watermelon Paleta Energy ($7.99), Jamaica Agua Fresca ($5.49), and Pumpkin Spice Horchata ($8.49).

qa.q: What's in the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: It's watermelon, chamoy and tajín mixed with Red Bull. It's $7.99.

qa.q: What's the Jamaica Agua Fresca?
qa.a: It's a hibiscus flavored drink, $5.49.

qa.q: What's the Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee?
qa.a: It's fresh brewed coffee, chilled, with Abuelita chocolate. It's $6.49.

qa.q: What's the Pumpkin Spice Horchata?
qa.a: It's a horchata drizzled and topped with whipped cream, $8.49.

qa.q: How much is the XL Chili Cheese Fries?
qa.a: $16.49. It has crispy fries, savory chili, cheese and grilled onions.

qa.q: Are the menu prices up to date?
qa.a: Prices in the app come from our public Yelp menu (Sep 2026) and may change. Please confirm in store.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: Nothing on the app menu has alcohol, and no app prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: Are there vegetarian options?
qa.a: The menu has churros and corn that don't list meat. I don't have full ingredient details, so please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have allergy information?
qa.a: I don't have allergy details. Please ask staff before ordering.

qa.q: Are there any specials right now?
qa.a: The app shows seasonal specials by date. Check the Specials card in the menu to see what's on now and what's coming up.

qa.q: What is the Halloween special?
qa.a: The Hot Cheetos Spooky Combo is Hot Cheetos Corn plus Filled Churros (2pc). It runs Oct 20–31, with code BOO. Sample special, so confirm price in store.

qa.q: What is the Thanksgiving special?
qa.a: The Pumpkin Spice Pair is a Pumpkin Spice Horchata plus Plain Signature Churros (4pc). It runs Nov 20–28.

qa.q: What is the Christmas special?
qa.a: The Holiday Churro Box is Churro Bites Filled (10pc) plus an Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee. It runs Dec 15–25.

qa.q: What is the New Year's special?
qa.a: The New Year's Loaded Share is XL Chili Cheese Fries plus Churro Bites Filled (10pc). It runs Dec 29–Jan 1.

qa.q: What is the Valentine's special?
qa.a: The Churro Date is two Churro Ice Cream Cones, one for you and one for your date. It runs Feb 7–14.

qa.q: What is the St. Patrick's Day special?
qa.a: Lucky Elote Fries is Original Elote Fries plus a Watermelon Paleta Energy. It runs Mar 14–17.

qa.q: What is the Cinco de Mayo special?
qa.a: The Cinco Street Combo is a Flamin Dog, Original Corn and a Jamaica Agua Fresca. It runs May 1–5.

qa.q: What is the Fourth of July special?
qa.a: The Fourth of July Churro Dog is a Churro Dog plus a Watermelon Paleta Energy. It runs Jul 1–4.

qa.q: Do the specials have prices?
qa.a: The app doesn't show prices for specials. Please ask staff for the price.

qa.q: Is there a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have a happy hour listed. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What is Loco Match?
qa.a: It's our free 90-second match-3 game. Line up 3 or more of the same snack to score, and see where you land on the weekly prize board.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap. Or swipe a snack toward its neighbor. Line up 3 or more of the same snack before 90 seconds run out.

qa.q: How do I start the game?
qa.a: Tap the game board (it says TAP TO PLAY) or press PLAY on the start screen.

qa.q: What are the game controls?
qa.a: Tap one snack, then tap its neighbor to swap them. You can also swipe a snack toward its neighbor.

qa.q: Why won't my swap work?
qa.a: Swaps only stick if they make a match of 3 or more. If not, the snacks swap back.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Each run is 90 seconds.

qa.q: How does scoring work in Loco Match?
qa.a: Each snack in a match is worth +10. A 4-in-a-row bonus is +40, a 5-in-a-row bonus is +100, and clearing the Churrito Man is +150.

qa.q: What are chain reactions?
qa.a: When falling snacks make new matches, you get a chain bonus of +15, +30, +45 and so on for each step.

qa.q: Who is the Churrito Man?
qa.a: He's our churro mascot on the board. Make a match right next to him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano and what does it do?
qa.a: The grilled Serrano is a hot pepper. Swipe or swap it and you lose 25 points. Leave it alone and it burns out by itself.

qa.q: How many points is each snack worth?
qa.a: Each snack in a match is +10: elote, XL chili cheese fries, filled churros, Abuelita choco horchata, and the sandía drink.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: Once per run a golden Antidote tile pops up. Make a match right next to it for +300. It's from Antidote's review of Churrito Loco.

qa.q: When does the golden Antidote tile appear?
qa.a: Once per run, somewhere between 20 and 40 seconds in.

qa.q: What is the halftime video?
qa.a: After about 80–90 seconds of total play, your next run opens with a short break showing Antidote The Foodie's review of Churrito Loco. You can skip it or go back to the game.

qa.q: How often can I play Loco Match?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free for members.

qa.q: Do I need tokens to play?
qa.a: No. Right now Loco Match is free for members. If tokens are turned on later, a play would cost 10 tokens, with free tokens every week and day.

qa.q: What does the weekly prize board do?
qa.a: It ranks the top scores of the week. 1st place wins 50% off their next order and 2nd wins 20% off.

qa.q: What do I win for 1st place?
qa.a: 50% off your next order for the highest score of the week.

qa.q: What do I win for 2nd place?
qa.a: 20% off your next order.

qa.q: What score gets me a prize?
qa.a: One run of 4,150 points or more earns 15% off your next order and a spot on the weekly board. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday. The week runs Monday through Sunday close.

qa.q: What happens if two players tie?
qa.a: The score posted first wins the tie.

qa.q: When do I get my weekly prize?
qa.a: I don't have a pickup schedule. Winners may be asked to show their code and account on their phone at the counter, so ask staff.

qa.q: Are the game prizes real?
qa.a: The prizes shown in the app are samples and the owner sets the real ones. Ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase or payment is needed to play, spin, or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Is Loco Match luck or skill?
qa.a: It's a game of skill. Prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, based on Los Angeles time. Spins are never sold and never cost tokens.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 pts, +100 pts, +75 pts, $1 off any churro, a free churro, a free horchata, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $1 off any churro 15%, free churro 8%, free horchata 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at our South Gate location.

qa.q: Are there limits on using spin prizes?
qa.a: One reward per visit. They can't be combined with other rewards, have no cash value, and can't be transferred.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards club?
qa.a: Create a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The live app confirms your phone with a text code.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, member accounts are free.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone, tied to the phone you made it on.

qa.q: What's the welcome offer for joining?
qa.a: A free churro with your next order.

qa.q: How old do I need to be to play?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Do you have a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have a kid mode in the app. Players under 18 need a parent or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do reward points work?
qa.a: Points from the spin and from purchases go into your Churrito Loco Rewards account. You trade them for rewards listed in the app. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get per game?
qa.a: Your game score doesn't turn into reward points. The game earns weekly board prizes. The Daily Spin can give +50, +75 or +100 points.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, and 1,100 pts Churros for the table.

qa.q: How many points for a free churro?
qa.a: 200 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free horchata?
qa.a: 400 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free loaded churro?
qa.a: 700 points.

qa.q: How many points for churros for the table?
qa.a: 1,100 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Pick a reward in the app once you have enough points, then show the code on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have level or tier details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have birthday reward details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes, the referral gift is a free churro. I don't have the exact steps, so ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for showing up?
qa.a: Show the nearby offer at the counter for double stars on today's churros.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have table ordering details. Please ask staff, or use Call to order once the number is live.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't see payment in the app. Please ask staff how to pay.

qa.q: Can I change the language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 button at the top right and pick a language like Español, 中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt and more.

qa.q: Can I add the app to my phone's home screen?
qa.a: Yes. On iPhone in Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android in Chrome tap Install app, or the ⋮ menu and Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Does the game lock my screen?
qa.a: Touching the game locks the page so it won't scroll while you play. Tap the pill on screen to unlock or lock it again.

qa.q: Can I pause the game?
qa.a: Yes, there's a Pause button during play. The menu also has settings, how to play, and points and prizes.

qa.q: What is the 3D button on food photos?
qa.a: Tap the 3D badge on a menu photo to see the dish on a spinning plate. Drag to spin it.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, the app has a Write a Google review button. No points or prizes are given for reviews. Honest reviews only.

qa.q: Will the app tell me when I'm nearby?
qa.a: If you turn on location and opt in, it can give you a heads-up when you're within a couple of miles. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Who do I ask if I need help?
qa.a: Ask staff at the counter. Questions about the game or rules can be asked there too.

qa.q: Do employees get prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: What happens with my personal info?
qa.a: It's used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Will I get marketing texts?
qa.a: Only if you opt in. You can stop anytime by replying STOP.

qa.q: Do the rules or prizes ever change?
qa.a: Yes, we may change or end the game, spin, prizes or rules, with notice in the app.

qa.q: Where can I read the official rules?
qa.a: Open the Official Rules link in the app. They are marked as a draft for now.
